text: No, the property has not lost its native forest. A small area (13.5 ha) of tree-cover loss was detected in 2025, but this does not establish deforestation or land-use change. The observation is pending corroboration, as it is the latest year in the series. Over 98% of the event area was confirmed as forest in 2020 (JRC GFC2020), and the affected area was identified as native forest (13.1 ha) by MGAP. No planted forest was involved. The change’s cause, persistence, legality, or responsible party cannot be determined from this data.
